data.title: Intensive Quran Memorization Review Program to Run at the Prophet's Mosque from November 21 to 28
data.content:
Madinah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Presidency of Religious Affairs has announced an intensive review program for Holy Quran memorizers at the Prophet's Mosque during the school fall break, running from November 21 to 28.
    Featuring three tracks covering the entire Quran, 20 parts, and 10 parts, the initiative aims to strengthen participants' mastery of their memorization and encourage productive engagement with the Holy Quran during the break.
    Sessions will take place daily from after the Fajr prayer until 11:15 a.m. at the Prophet's Mosque, near Gate 22.
    -- SPA
